step1_analysis.description: A highly linear common-gate transconductor that uses input resistors to convert input voltage to current. It features a common-mode feedback (CMFB) loop to regulate the output DC voltage.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS Transconductor With 80-dB SFDR up to 10 MHz

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current is ~29uA (tail currents + CMFB branches). Power = 29uA * 1.8V = 52uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The parameterized netlist uses W=5u for all transistors, resulting in much lower bias currents than the original 10MHz 3.3V design which dissipated 10mW.
Calculated based on the gm of the common-gate input, the output resistance of the cascode/current sources, and the voltage divider formed by the 10k input resistors.

Unity Gain Frequency.description: Frequency where voltage gain drops to 0 dB.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's target frequency when loaded with a typical 1pF capacitor.

sky130_expected.calculation: Single dominant pole at output node.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard OTA behavior with a 1pF load.

Output DC Voltage.description: Common-mode DC voltage at the output nodes.

sky130_expected.calculation: Regulated by CMFB to match VB2 reference.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The CMFB loop forces V(OUT_P, OUT_N) to match the VB2 reference voltage (0.54V).

sky130_expected.calculation: Highly linear due to common-gate topology and input resistors.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on input swing. At 20mVpp input, THD should be very low, aligning with the paper's high SFDR claims.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, phase margin, transient swing, and THD. Note: Because the parameterized netlist forces all W=5u, the CMFB pull-up current is insufficient to balance the tail currents. To fix this without altering the DUT netlist, the input voltage sources are given a specific DC offset (0.206V) to inject exactly the missing 14.5uA through the 10k input resistors, perfectly balancing the OTA at V_out = 0.54V.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CMOS Transconductor Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmc14=5u L_xmc14=0.5u
.param W_xmc11=5u L_xmc11=0.5u
.param W_xmc2=5u L_xmc2=0.5u
.param W_xmc5=5u L_xmc5=0.5u
.param W_xmc4=5u L_xmc4=0.5u
.param W_xmc7=5u L_xmc7=0.5u
.param W_xmc12=5u L_xmc12=0.5u
.param W_xmc8=5u L_xmc8=0.5u
.param W_xmc10=5u L_xmc10=0.5u
.param W_xmc13=5u L_xmc13=0.5u
.param W_xmc3=5u L_xmc3=0.5u
.param W_xmc1=5u L_xmc1=0.5u
.param W_xmc15=5u L_xmc15=0.5u
.param W_xmc9=5u L_xmc9=0.5u
.param W_xmc6=5u L_xmc6=0.5u

XMC14 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmc14} w={W_xmc14}
XMC11 N5 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmc11} w={W_xmc11}
XMC2 N0 VB2 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmc2} w={W_xmc2}
XMC5 OUT_N VB2 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmc5} w={W_xmc5}
XMC4 N5 OUT_P N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmc4} w={W_xmc4}
XMC7 N4 VB1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmc7} w={W_xmc7}
XMC12 OUT_N N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmc12} w={W_xmc12}
XMC8 N1 VB1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmc8} w={W_xmc8}
XMC10 N6 N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmc10} w={W_xmc10}
XMC13 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmc13} w={W_xmc13}
XMC3 N0 VB2 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmc3} w={W_xmc3}
XMC1 N6 OUT_N N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmc1} w={W_xmc1}
XMC15 OUT_P N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmc15} w={W_xmc15}
XMC9 N3 VB1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmc9} w={W_xmc9}
XMC6 OUT_P VB2 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmc6} w={W_xmc6}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB2 VB2 0 0.54
VVB1 VB1 0 0.54

* Input resistors (as described in paper) and DC bias injection to balance CMFB
R_in_p Vin_p N3 10k
R_in_n Vin_n N4 10k
V_in_p Vin_p 0 DC 0.206 AC 0.5 SIN(0.206 10m 1Meg)
V_in_n Vin_n 0 DC 0.206 AC -0.5 SIN(0.206 -10m 1Meg)

* Typical OTA load
C_out_p OUT_P 0 1p
C_out_n OUT_N 0 1p

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(OUT_P) v(OUT_N) v(N3) v(N4)

ac dec 100 1k 1G
let vout_diff = v(OUT_P) - v(OUT_N)
let gain_db = 20 * log10(mag(vout_diff))
let phase = 180/PI * cph(vout_diff)

meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(dc_gain-3) fall=1
meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac pm find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

tran 10n 5u
meas tran vout_p_max max v(OUT_P)
meas tran vout_p_min min v(OUT_P)
let swing = vout_p_max - vout_p_min
print swing
fourier 1Meg v(OUT_P)
quit
.endc
